title: Add remote operator health endpoint covering gateway status, worker availability, queue depth, active jobs, recent failures, and policy blocks
summary: Expose inspectable health for the remote operator foundation before live gateway deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: Health reports available state, dry-run/live mode, configured gateways, active jobs, pending approvals, failures, policy blocks, and emergency stop.
Health is available through a local CLI status command.
Dashboard panels can consume the same health summary.
reviewNotes: Implemented RemoteOperatorHealth, remote_operator_health, hermes operator status, and remote operator dashboard health/job/inbox panels.
